reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed with the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already implements the missing/number/furthest-from-zero range rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; one field assignment and one type field.

placement.why: The mapping lives in scheduleModel.toExternal where API output is shaped, but the read-only field is added to APIScheduleEntity, which is also the create/update input type.

scope.why: Only the API model and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Putting an output-only field on the shared input/output APIScheduleEntity type lets create/update callers (Omit<APIScheduleEntity,'id'>, Partial<APIScheduleEntity>) supply it, relying on a comment to say it is read-only; no tests cover the new field.
